name: Helm of Telepathy
description: A close helm of dark steel with a crystal set over the brow.
body:
## What it does

Whenever you like, you can read the surface thoughts of those around you, as the detect thoughts spell does, and speak into the mind of anyone whose thoughts you are reading. Once a day you can also plant a suggestion in that mind.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.note: on a creature whose thoughts you are reading

features.name: Telepathy
features.text: While you read a creature's thoughts, you can speak telepathically to it.
